summary: Vision Marine Technologies filed a Form 6-K reporting a non-binding LOI for a reverse takeover by an undisclosed defense-focused counterparty. Existing shareholders would retain ~2.9% of the combined company pre-financing, implying a change of control. The board also approved a 1-for-10 reverse stock split and voluntarily delisted from TSXV. No price, premium, or advisor disclosed. Watch for binding agreement, financing terms, and regulatory approvals.
